quarterly_data.signal: A Nature Methods paper validated Nautilus's Iterative Mapping on tau: the Nautilus Tau Proteoforms Assay (12 site-specific antibodies, up to 768 resolvable proteoform groups) quantified 130 tau proteoform groups, measured proteoforms at 0.1% of a sample and delivered a median CV below 5.5%. The tau assay is currently available through the Iterative Mapping Early Access Program; the same approach is being applied to alpha-synuclein in Parkinson's disease and to AKT1, expected to enter the EAP in late 2026, and two additional oncology targets have cleared Nautilus' development criteria. Voyager flow cells are designed for up to 10 billion intact protein molecules, with machine learning converting probe-binding patterns into proteoform identifications.
